pulse.title: Pulse GT · PX-01
pulse.notes: Balanced ion racer. Dorsal stabiliser fin, twin ion thrusters, split rear wing.

vortex.title: Vortex R9 · VX-R9
vortex.notes: Razor-handling wedge. Low forward cockpit, twin blade outriggers on carbon struts.

solar.title: Solar Wraith · SW-77
solar.notes: Maximum-velocity interceptor. Needle nose with ring intake, twin booster nacelles, twin tails.

prism.title: Prism Titan · PT-X
prism.notes: Shielded quantum collector. Boxy armoured hull, side armour pods, floating prism core, ram bar.

barrier.title: Pulse Barricade
barrier.notes: Lane-blocking energy barricade. 38 base damage. Hazard-striped face plates.

mine.title: Ion Mine
mine.notes: Floating proximity mine. 46 base damage. Twelve emitter spikes and a warning halo.

drone.title: Sentinel Drone
drone.notes: Weaving sentry drone. 34 base damage. Armoured core, swept wings, twin rotor rings.

coin.title: Quantum Coin
coin.notes: Chain coins for combo multipliers up to ×5.

boostPad.title: Warp Boost Pad
boostPad.notes: Flush road pad. Speed ×1.13 +4 m/s, +34 nitro, +6 coins.

gate.title: Checkpoint Arch
gate.notes: Spans the full 18 m Grand Prix raceway. Start/finish variant carries the checker header.
